_status: DRAFT — proposed, not approved. Merge into requirements.json only after review.
_note: FIN-001 (append-only double-entry ledger) is ALREADY APPROVED and is not restated. These entries add what FIN-001 needs in order to be satisfiable, plus the flows around it.

requirements.title: Every ledger transaction balances to zero per currency
requirements.rationale: FIN-001 approves double-entry but defines no accounts, entries or balance rule, and LEDGER_TRANSACTION_UNBALANCED is unreachable. Enforced by a deferred database constraint so an unbalanced transaction cannot be committed even by faulty application code. An unbalanced ledger means the platform cannot say where the money is.

requirements.title: Ledger entries are append-only; corrections are reversing entries
requirements.rationale: No UPDATE or DELETE on posted entries, enforced by trigger. A mistake is corrected by a new transaction that references what it reverses, so the history of a correction is itself auditable.

requirements.title: Amounts are integer minor units with an explicit currency
requirements.rationale: ADR-027 approves integer money and explicit FX. Reuses the approved money.schema.json unchanged. No floating point anywhere in the finance domain.

requirements.title: Currency conversion records the rate, its source and its timestamp
requirements.rationale: Sponsors pay in one currency and payees are paid in another. A conversion whose rate cannot be reproduced later is not auditable, and the difference accrues to somebody.

requirements.title: Card data never touches the platform
requirements.rationale: Payment is taken through a hosted checkout so card details go directly to a licensed provider. The platform stores only a provider reference. This keeps PCI scope minimal and removes an entire class of breach from the codebase.

requirements.title: Payouts require a granted dual-control approval bound to the exact batch
requirements.rationale: finance.payout.approve is already approved as critical, aal3, dual_control. Execution without a granted approval is refused by a database constraint, and the approval binds to the specific batch so lines cannot be added after approval.

requirements.title: Payees are verified before they can be paid
requirements.rationale: The provider performs KYB on a business before it may receive funds. The platform records verification status and refuses payment to an unverified payee. OPEN QUESTION: sanctions screening obligations remain with the organization.

requirements.title: A sponsorship is a commitment with a reporting obligation
requirements.rationale: Telling a sponsor 'your tree is cared for' is a material claim under EVID-001. A sponsorship therefore carries an explicit reporting obligation traceable to tree observations, so the promise can be checked rather than assumed.

requirements.title: Only trees on approved land may be sponsored
requirements.rationale: Accepting money against land whose boundary has not been approved, or whose authority to commit was never established, sells something that may not exist. Requires an approved boundary (GEO-002) and a party holding an authority-bearing land role (LAND-002).

requirements.title: Refunds and chargebacks reverse both the ledger and the sponsorship
requirements.rationale: A refunded or charged-back payment must not leave an active sponsorship, or a sponsor retains a tree they did not pay for and the platform's public counts overstate reality.
